messages.Z_MISSING: {{serial}} has receipts on {{date}} but no Z report was recorded
messages.Z_MISMATCH: Z report {{report}} ({{serial}}, {{date}}) differs from the receipts recorded in the system
messages.Z_NUMBER_GAP: {{serial}}: Z {{prev}} is followed by Z {{z}}. {{missing}} Z report(s) are missing
messages.UNRECEIPTED_ORDER: Order {{order}} ({{customer}}) was confirmed on {{date}} and still has no EFD receipt
messages.UNRECEIPTED_ORDER_NO_CUSTOMER: Order {{order}} was confirmed on {{date}} and still has no EFD receipt
messages.RECEIPT_NUMBER_GAP: {{serial}}: receipt {{prev}} is followed by {{receipt}}. {{missing}} receipt number(s) are not recorded
messages.RECON_MISSING: {{serial}} on {{date}}: Z report {{report}} has not been reconciled
messages.Z_PENDING_OLD: Z report {{report}} ({{serial}}, {{date}}) has been waiting for verification for {{days}} days
messages.RECON_DRIFT: Reconciliation {{recon}} ({{serial}}, {{date}}) no longer matches the receipts in the system

list.title: Difference detection
list.subtitle: A read-only scan of the fiscal records for things that do not add up: missing or mismatched Z reports, skipped numbers, orders without receipts and days that were never reconciled. Nothing is changed by the scan.
list.chipTitle: Show only this kind of finding
list.tooLong: Scan at most {{max}} days at a time.
list.capped: One kind of finding hit the limit of {{cap}}, so the counts are not complete. Narrow the dates or pick a device.
list.deviceNote: Orders do not belong to a device, so “{{type}}” is not checked while one device is selected.
list.scanned: Scanned {{from}} to {{to}} (time zone {{tz}}) · {{at}}. Expected is what the records say it should be; Actual is what was found; Difference is Actual minus Expected.
list.emptyClean: No differences found for this period. Everything adds up.

view.title: Difference finding
view.compareHelp: Expected is what the records say it should be; Actual is what was found; Difference is Actual minus Expected.
view.noFigures: This finding has no figures to compare.
view.notFound: This finding could not be found. It may have been fixed since the last scan.
